```{r, echo=FALSE, include=T,fig.width=7, fig.height= 6}
 hist1<-range.dat %>% filter(sim.id=="base.values") %>% select(-weight, -population, -range_bygroup) %>% distinct()
test<-hist1 %>% select(all_of(c(vary_cols,vary_colsJ))) %>% distinct()
hist2<-range.dat %>% filter(sim.id=="sd.school" & sd.school==0) %>% select(-weight, -population, -range_bygroup) %>% distinct()
test2<-hist2 %>% select(all_of(c(vary_cols,vary_colsJ))) %>% distinct()

 hist3<-range.dat %>% filter(sim.id=="n.bar" & group=="performance_1" & n.bar==25) %>% select(-weight, -population, -range_bygroup) %>% distinct()
test3<-hist3 %>% select(all_of(c(vary_cols,vary_colsJ))) %>% distinct()
``````````

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=T,fig.width=7, fig.height= 6}

range.collapse<-range.dat %>% select(-weight, -population, -range_bygroup) %>% distinct() %>%
                          group_by()


ggplot(data=hist1,aes(x=range))+
  geom_histogram(binwidth =.01)+
  labs(x="Range Across Estimators Within a Single Simulation Replication")

ggplot(data=as.data.frame(hist2),aes(x=range))+
  geom_histogram(binwidth =.01)+
  labs(x="Range Across Estimators Within a Single Simulation Replication")


ggplot(data=as.data.frame(hist3),aes(x=range))+
  geom_histogram(binwidth =.01)+
  labs(x="Range Across Estimators Within a Single Simulation Replication")
``````````
